browser.fixtureIssue: The initial QA-only fingerprint attempted crypto.subtle on HTTP where it is unavailable. Replaced that test helper with FNV-1a, then repeated verification. The application source did not use that QA code. Browser extension errors were excluded.

tests: Bounded and deduplicated database opens; blocked/late open and upgrade cleanup.
Network-aware own/latest/regional/legacy checkpoint priority in one read transaction.
Read timeouts release temporary solo controls without any writes, including late callbacks.
Corrupt snapshots, wrong network, malformed notes never replace active state or overwrite stored checkpoints.
Valid restores advance deterministically and commit snapshot/latest pointer together.
Write failures/timeouts abort, never announce saved, and stop automatic retry.
Queued writes copy engine references before awaits and eventually retain latest notes/state.

preserved: Original HTMLs and Incheon 4 institutions / 12 directed routes.
1394 saved road ways and all geography/data.
Shared engine, biology rules, reproducibility and statistics.
Four top-level whole pages and LIVE / TIMELAPSE / COMPUTE.
Other PinCon paths and root service worker.
limits: Draft review branch only; no main modification, merge, manual deployment, DNS or new host.
Production collaboration API remains 404; no configured HTTPS Node/WebSocket host.
Each database stage has its own 5-second bound; this is not a total 5-second startup deadline.
Quota/write failures and blocked/late upgrade behavior were tested with a transaction mock, not physical device exhaustion.
Browser native IndexedDB was exercised on an HTTP fixture with an isolated database name, not production storage.
HTTP batch against loopback could not reach the managed preview namespace; 32 cache paths were statically resolved, with browser initialization and public production HTTP checked separately.
No actual Galaxy Tab, file://, airplane mode, long wall-clock run or device performance claim.
Full statistical result schema validation on restored result objects was not added in this change.
